images.alt: Mother's Day card: Marvel United Rogue and Mystique, captioned "Here's to finally getting to know the real you!"
Mother's Day card: Marvel United Cable with his big gun facing Mystique, captioned "I would time-travel to be with you today!"
Mother's Day card: Rogue, Nightcrawler and Mystique together, captioned "All families have challenges... ours has more than most!"
Mother's Day card: Cable and Mystique, captioned "I love you, clone or not!"
Mother's Day card: Rogue and Mystique, captioned "You taught me how to survive. The rest... ah'm still learnin'."
Mother's Day card: Rogue, Nightcrawler and Mystique, captioned "Some families hug. Ours infiltrates government agencies."
